reasoning_steps.description: Identify the structure of the finite field. Since 81 = 3^4, we have F_81 = F_{3^4}, which is a degree 4 extension of F_3.
Understand the condition F_81 = F_3(α). This means α generates the entire field F_81 over F_3, so the minimal polynomial of α over F_3 must have degree 4.
Identify proper subfields of F_81 containing F_3. The subfields correspond to divisors of 4, so proper subfields are F_3 (degree 1) and F_9 = F_{3^2} (degree 2).
Count elements in T. An element α ∈ F_81 satisfies F_3(α) = F_81 iff α ∉ F_9 (since F_9 contains all elements with minimal polynomial degree < 4).
Calculate the final result. 81 - 9 = 72 elements in T.

verification.check_method: Verified the subfield lattice of F_81 = F_3^4. Proper subfields containing F_3 correspond to divisors of 4 less than 4 (i.e., 1 and 2), which are F_3 and F_9. Since F_3 ⊂ F_9, the union of all proper subfields is F_9. The condition F_3(α) = F_81 is equivalent to α ∉ F_9. The calculation |F_81| - |F_9| = 81 - 9 = 72 is correct.

educational_hint: For F_{p^n}, the number of elements generating the whole field over F_p is p^n - p^d where d is the largest proper divisor of n. Here n=4, d=2, so 3^4 - 3^2 = 81 - 9 = 72.
cache_matched_question: 设$\\mathbb{F}_{81}$为$81$元的有限域。$T=\\{\\alpha\\in\\mathbb{F}_{81}|\\mathbb{F}_{81}=\\mathbb{F}_3(\\alpha)\\}$。求$T$中元素的个数。
